# Priyanshu Shishodia

> One person doing video editing, content creation, brand websites and
> full-stack product development, start to finish.

Priyanshu Shishodia is a video editor and full-stack developer. The site
is a small studio gate: one person, four services, each with its own
work samples and contact point.

## Services

- [Video editing](https://shishodious.github.io/video): cuts, colour and
  pacing for short-form, ads, podcasts, corporate films and documentary —
  tools include CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects and Premiere Pro.
- [Content creation](https://shishodious.github.io/content): short-form
  content built around a creator's voice and audience.
- [Brand websites](https://shishodious.github.io/brand): brand-led
  marketing sites, from process through SEO/AEO to the finished build.
- [Apps & products](https://shishodious.github.io/apps): full-stack web
  products and AI systems, from first commit to production — React,
  Node.js and modern infrastructure.
